result.stdout:
Description:
  Manage EAC authentication and token storage.

Usage:
  eac auth [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --pretty        Pretty-print JSON output for human inspection.

Commands:
  login     Login through a provider and store a server token in the active credential store.
  status    Show stored authentication for the selected server/provider.
  logout    Remove stored authentication from the active credential store.
  token     Manage server-issued EAC auth tokens for the active credential store.
  approval  Request, inspect, and cancel supervisor approvals.
  evaluate  Show the current user's native authorization decisions for exact published contract operations without invoking them.

result.stdout:
Description:
  Login through a provider and store a server token in the active credential store.

Usage:
  eac auth login [options]

Options:
  --provider <provider>              Identity provider. Defaults to eternet. [default: eternet]
  --server <server>                  EAC auth server URL. Defaults to EAC_AUTH_SERVER_URL, EAC_GATEWAY_AUTH_SERVER_URL, EAC_SERVER_URL, or the gateway auth server. [default: https://api.eternet.cc]
  --token-name <token-name>          Server token display name. [default: eac cli on runnervm3lb7s]
  --no-browser                       Print the login URL without opening the browser.
  --device                           Use the provider device flow through the Eternet API Gateway.
  --resource-scope <resource-scope>  Explicit Identity resource scope; repeat for multiple resources. Requires --provider identity.
  --format <format>                  Output format: json or text. [default: json]
  -?, -h, --help                     Show help and usage information
  --pretty                           Pretty-print JSON output for human inspection.

result.stdout:
Description:
  Request supervisor approval for one authorization context.

Usage:
  eac auth approval request [options]

Options:
  --namespace <namespace> (REQUIRED)            Authorization namespace (for example Auth).
  --route-template <route-template> (REQUIRED)  Route template protected by approval.
  --operation <operation> (REQUIRED)            CRUD operation (Read, Create, Update, Delete).
  --permission-key <permission-key>             Optional permission key for the protected operation; route/CRUD authorization does not require one.
  --reason <reason>                             Optional request or cancellation reason.
  --expires-in-minutes <expires-in-minutes>     Optional custom approval lifetime in minutes. [default: 0]
  --format <format>                             Output format: json or text. [default: json]
  -?, -h, --help                                Show help and usage information
  --pretty                                      Pretty-print JSON output for human inspection.
